div.l: Wheiþ̉er it were cold / hote / moist / or drye
And wher of it engendered / and of what humoᵘur
He was a verray ꝑparfyt/ practisour
The cause he knew / and of his harm the rote
A non he ȝaf / the syke man his bote
Ful redy had he / alle hise appoticaries
To sende him dragges / and his lettuaries
For eche of hēm / mad other for to wynne
Her ffrenshipe / was nat newe / to bygynne
Wel knew he / the old Esculapius
And deiscorides / and eke Rusus
Olde ypocras / and Galyen
Serapyoıı̄un / Raȝis / and Auyȝen
Auuerrois / Dasmacien / and Costantyn
Bernard / Gatisden̄ / and Gilbertyn
Of his diete / mesurable was he
For he was / of no suꝑperfluite
But of gret norisshyng / and digestible
his stody was but litel / in the bible
In Sangweyn / and in pers / clad wᵗith alle
Lyned wᵗith taffata / and sendalle
And ȝet he was but esy of dispence
For he kept þᵗat he wan / in the pestilence
For gold in phisyk / is a ccordiall
Therfore he loued gold / in especiall.
A good wyf þ̉ere was / of beside bathe¶ the Wyf of Bathe
But she was somdel def / ⁊and þᵗat was skathe
Of cloth makyng / she had swich an haunt
That she passed hem / of ypris ⁊and of gaunt
In all the ꝑparyssh / wyf was there non
That to offryng / a forn̄ hire shuld gon
And if there dide / serteyn so wroth was she
That she was oute / of al charite
Hire kerches / were of fyn ground
I durst swere / they weyed doun a pound
That on the Sonday / were vp on hire hede
Hire hosen were / of fyn skarlet rede
Ful streite teyed / and shoon moist ⁊and newe
Bold was hire face / and feir ⁊and rede of hewe
She was a worthy wōmman / al hire lyue
Housbondes at þe chirche dore / had she had fyue
Wᵗith outen other companye / in hire ȝouthe
But ther of nedeth nat / to speke of nouthe
